wake-dispatch.transcript: I kept the civilian line open. Someone is replacing its bearings with obstruction reports. The Foundry Service Reader can identify the routing mark.

array-false-corridor.transcript: The advertised civilian corridor leads into the patrol line. S-007 carried passengers before this war. You are one of many we tried to help, not an assignment. There are seeds and family records at the orchard. Carry them if you choose.
